en: Black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view of several substantial brick buildings set behind a fence and trees, likely part of a military complex. The main foreground building is an ornate, multi‑storey structure with gabled roof and decorative brickwork, surrounded by a garden or lawn. The image has printed red German text at the top identifying the place and the function of the building.
